blocks.content:
• TRAI is a statutory body.
• Established in 1997.
• TDSAT created in 2000.
• Regulates telecom tariffs.
• Headquarters in New Delhi.

rows: Statutory body, regulates telecom tariffs, HQ in New Delhi

items: TRAI is a statutory body created in 1997, not a constitutional body.
Note the timeline trap: TRAI was established in 1997, whereas TDSAT was created in 2000.
TRAI regulates telecom tariffs and is headquartered in New Delhi.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: TRAI was established as a statutory body in 1997.
TDSAT was created later in the year 2000.
TRAI's primary mandate includes regulating telecom tariffs.
The headquarters of TRAI are located in New Delhi.
